logs.app-logs.name: Old logs of your apps
logs.app-logs.what: Records apps write about what they did, kept for finding problems. Nothing has written to these files for at least a week.
logs.app-logs.made-by: The apps themselves and parts of macOS; the folder a log is in usually names its app.
logs.app-logs.if-removed: The files go to the Trash and their folders stay, so each app finds its log folder where it left it. A log changed recently is kept, and one in use when you confirm is skipped.
logs.app-logs.comes-back: Apps write new logs as they run. The old records do not come back.
logs.crash-reports.name: Old crash reports
logs.crash-reports.what: Reports macOS writes when an app crashes, stops responding or uses too much of your Mac, to help its developer find the cause.
logs.crash-reports.made-by: macOS, for every app and part of the system.
logs.crash-reports.if-removed: The reports go to the Trash and leave Console's list of reports. Nothing else changes. If you mean to send one to its developer, do it first.
logs.crash-reports.comes-back: A new report is written the next time something crashes. The old ones do not come back.
logs.enabled.label: Logs and crash reports
logs.enabled.description: Finds old logs and crash reports in your Library. The files go to the Trash; their folders stay.
logs.older-than-days.label: Offer logs and crash reports unchanged for
logs.older-than-days.description: Anything changed more recently is kept. It cannot be set below 7 days, so the check never becomes less careful.
logs.title: {name}
logs.reason.top: In your Logs folder, unchanged for {days} days.
logs.reason.folder: In {folder} in your Logs folder, unchanged for {days} days.
logs.reason.report: A crash or diagnostic report, unchanged for {days} days.
logs.left-out.scan-again: Shown from the last scan. Scan again to check how old it is.
logs.left-out.special: A program uses it to talk to another program, so it is kept.
logs.left-out.not-yours: It belongs to the system or another user; removing it needs an administrator.
logs.left-out.locked: It is locked. To let Fresher remove it, unlock it in Finder's Get Info.
logs.left-out.recent: Written or changed recently; an app may still be using it.
